protocol_parsing.description: Estratégias para extrair estrutura de protocolos textuais
protocol_parsing.prompt_template:
Analyze this clinical protocol and extract the decision tree structure:
{protocol_text}
For each element, identify: 1. Type (decision/action/assessment/endpoint/reference) 2. Content (what the node says) 3. Connections (what comes next, with conditions) 4. Evidence level if mentioned
Return as structured JSON with nodes and edges.
